title: Are Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) Suitable for Imbalanced Data Classification?
abstract: arXiv:2507.14121v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) parameterize each connection as a learnable univariate B-spline, offering native feature-level interpretability. Whether this locality helps or hinders under class imbalance, where minority sparsity may leave spline edges without enough local observations to update reliably, remains unexamined. We evaluate KANs against capacity-matched Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs) and XGBoost across ten imbalanced tabular datasets under three conditions: native class distribution, Focal Loss, and SMOTE-Tomek resampling, within a parameter-parity, two-phase framework. Under the native distribution, KAN spline activations collapse in minority-sparse regions, showing stronger majority-class bias than the matched MLP. translated_title: Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）适用于不平衡数据分类吗？
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）将每条连接参数化为可学习的单变量 B 样条，天然具备特征级可解释性。然而，这种局部性在类别不平衡场景下究竟是利还是弊——即少数类样本稀疏可能导致样条边缺乏足够的局部观测以进行可靠更新——此前尚未被研究。我们在参数量对等、两阶段的框架下，将 KAN 与容量匹配的多层感知机（MLP）和 XGBoost 在十个不平衡表格数据集上进行评估，涵盖三种条件：原生类别分布、Focal Loss 以及 SMOTE-Tomek 重采样。在原生类别分布下，KAN 的样条激活在少数类稀疏区域发生崩塌，表现出比匹配 MLP 更强的多数类偏置。Focal Loss 几乎未带来改善，因为它只是对梯度进行重加权，而未能提供判别性曲率所需的局部化观测。相反，SMOTE-Tomek 重采样使样条激活得以恢复，使 KAN 能够发挥其表达能力（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文首次系统评估了 KAN 在类别不平衡表格数据分类中的表现，发现其样条局部性在原生不平衡分布下会成为劣势（少数类稀疏区域激活崩塌、多数类偏置加重），Focal Loss 无济于事，而 SMOTE-Tomek 重采样能为样条提供所需的局部观测从而有效缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This is the first systematic study of KANs under class imbalance, showing that their spline locality becomes a liability on natively imbalanced tabular data, that Focal Loss offers negligible benefit, and that SMOTE-Tomek resampling restores reliable spline updates and KAN performance.
